passages.note: Aye on Assembly concurrence in Senate amendments, the final Assembly vote on the chaptered text; 16 of 79 voting No, so not near-unanimous.

passages.provision_quote: shall not enact or enforce any policy, rule, or administrative regulation that would require an employee or a contractor to disclose any information related to a pupil’s sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression to any other person without the pupil’s consent, unless otherwise required by state or federal law.
passages.note: Chaptered text, the version the concurrence vote enacted; Section 220.5 forbids school rules that require disclosure, and Section 220.3 only says staff are not required to disclose, so it does not order staff to withhold (rung 1).

rows.reasoning: Pacheco voted Aye on final Assembly passage (concurrence, 61-16) of AB 1955. Its operative Section 220.5 says school entities "shall not enact or enforce any policy, rule, or administrative regulation that would require an employee or a contractor to disclose" a pupil's gender identity without the pupil's consent, which matches "Forbid rules that require schools to tell parents." The bill says only that staff "shall not be required to disclose"; it does not order them to keep the information from parents, which rules out "Require staff to keep a student's gender identity from parents unless the student consents."
